categoryId.title: Category
categoryId.description: Which Kickstarter category to search, as a category id. Design is 7, Film and Video is 10, Games is 12, Technology is 16. One category per run.

states.title: Project states to include
states.description: Live campaigns are still actively raising money. Failed campaigns already ended without reaching their goal. Successful projects are never searched.

sort.title: Sort order
sort.description: How Kickstarter orders results within each state.

maxPagesPerState.title: Maximum search pages per state
maxPagesPerState.description: Kickstarter caps out at roughly two hundred pages per query regardless.

maxProjects.title: Maximum underfunded projects to process (0 = unlimited)
maxProjects.description: Stop after this many. Keep this small for a first test, since every project here reads through a real, slower browser.

crawlCreatorSites.title: Also read the creator's own website
crawlCreatorSites.description: Reads the homepage of any linked site found, still through the same cleared browser.

maxSitePagesEach.title: Maximum outside sites to check per project
maxSitePagesEach.description: How many of a project's own linked websites to check before moving on.

minimumScore.title: Minimum quality score to keep an address
minimumScore.description: Zero to one hundred. Fifty five keeps medium and high confidence, seventy five keeps high confidence only.

challengeWaitMinutes.title: Minutes to wait for a human to clear a challenge
challengeWaitMinutes.description: How long the run pauses and waits, live view open, before giving up if nobody solves what is shown.
